A decadent imperial milk stout, luxuriously full-bodied and smooth, layered with rich chocolate orange zest, aromatic vanilla, and creamy Tonka bean. A year of careful barrel aging adds warm oak, subtle caramel, and gentle spirit notes, enhancing its complexity. The

Each sip delivers a lingering, velvety finish where barrel-aged depth meets aromatic richness, making this stout bold and truly luxurious drinking experience.

Giant Coney takes everything you love about our award-winning Coney and supersizes it. Named after the old meaning of coney – rabbit – and inspired by York’s iconic Coney Street, first recorded around 1150 as Cuningstrete or the King’s Street, this is the bigger, bolder member of the family.

A smooth, pillowy body supports the intensified hop character, while a restrained bitterness keeps every sip dangerously drinkable.

Inspired by the legend of William’s alleged poisoning from a chalice during Mass, this commemorative best bitter offers a far more enjoyable ending. Part of the Minster’s 2026 Crafting a Legacy celebrations, Poisoned Chalice honours York’s rich artisan heritage — from medieval craftsmen to modern craft brewers. A beer rooted in history, brewed for today

beers.description: NEIPA w/ Citra 3 ways - T90, Lupomax and Spectrum. It’s no secret that Colin loves citra, so we’ve had a play with this one. Layers of Citra on Citra on Citra, dry hopped at different stages with different types, to amplify the hop flavour. Huge citrus, tropical fruit and sticky resinous flavours throughout.

beers.name: Got A Train To Catch
beers.description: Soft and pillowy, with peach and zesty tangerine on the nose, followed by juicy tropical fruit and a little tickle of blackcurrant from Audacia, Idaho 7 and Luminosa hops, with a sweet malty finish.

beers.name: Stay In Your Lane
beers.description: Brewed with Cascade for that classic West Coast bitterness, then dry hopped with Enigma & Strata for juicy melon, passionfruit and plenty of piney, resinous character. A modern take on a classic West Coast pale. [GLUTEN FREE]

beers.name: Don't Make Up Stories
beers.description: Juicy, fruity, tangy and tartly sour. Packed with plump, jammy blueberries, rounded out with juicy peach and finished with a vanilla sweetness. Bright, tangy and fruity AF.

beers.name: Kastenbräu
beers.description:
CRISP | REFRESHING | MALTY

Brewed to Bavarian standards, Kastenbräu has been laying low in horizontal lagering tanks for an authentic clean crisp flavour and smooth drinkability. Light and refreshing with a subtle malt sweetness.

beers.name: Herding Chickens
beers.description: Light, crisp, fragrant and fruity, this is a summer beer made for sunshine and relaxed times drinking in a field somewhere, pref. with a tent up and a BBQ cookin'. Notes of lemon zest, soft pear drop and a light floral finish keep it bright, dry and refreshing.

beers.name: Hocus Pocus Soft Focus
beers.description: A soft and fuzzy pale ale made for some seasonal supping. Light and fruity, this thirst quenching little number is packed with apricot puree for loads of soft stone fruit character, backed by bright hits of Centennial bringing citrus zest and a slight floral edge.

beers.name: Wuzza Wuzza
beers.description: An easy-drinking hazy pale with soft peach and citrus, gentle tropical notes of papaya, pineapple and nectarine, and a finish that snaps with pink lemonade brightness and a subtle dank edge. With Luminosa, Strata and Nectaron.

beers.name: Lully
beers.description:
MELON | MANGO | GUAVA

No frills needed for this delightful pale ale. Lully, our only core beer tastes like a citrus dream. Hopped with 100% Citra, this easy-sipping, mellow hazy pale ale brings tons of those sherbet citrussy aromas with a big beefy mouthfeel that punches well above its weight. It’s juicy, fruity, and easy drinking - everything you’d want from a session pale ale.

Hops: Citra, Citra, Citra

beers.name: Nonsense Nonsense
beers.description: A double take on our core beer, Lully. All citra hops give out bright and zesty citrus, ripe mango on the nose with peach and a touch of pine. Full, hazy and pillowy with juicy tropical fruit and lemen sherbert flavours.

beers.name: In The Club Style
beers.description: This smooth and easy drinking number packs cocoa hints, rich and creamy espresso and the rounded fruitiness from hedgerow berries in a perfectly balanced harmony of flavour and finesse.
